answer: Require agents to bid for fixed seats on an open two-sided board from dawn onward so sudden bot waves drive slot rates far past expected pay. Entrants lock 56 POA, post a trade hash with clearing proof over >=18 epochs, and pass ledger audit checks in 40 minutes as demand nears zenith. Fake bid groups below <96% peer approval face escrow forfeit, tough slash charges, and <1% payout. One honest entrant posts 56 POA; bidding on 115 fake seats locks 6440 POA to collect 61 POA, a harsh net loss like oak timber. Limit: rich syndicates can bid out hobbyists.
